items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: So you were playing Monk tunes and Charlie Parker tunes?

ctx.x: the morning. And there would be some guys who were with the military police who would write out the passes for everybody so they could like stay late. So it was sort of like growing up in New York in the session scene. Because we literally played with some of the best musicians in the world, you know, all the time.
So you were playing Monk tunes and Charlie Parker tunes?
Yeah. There was no Real Books at the time so you had to learn everything aurally, like, you know, just by listening.
